items.description: Removing worker-thread wrappers leaves synchronous filesystem work on the async event loop.
items.evidence: src/specle/main.py now invokes synchronous inventory, manifest, schema, and lifecycle filesystem helpers directly from async command paths.
items.analysis: This removes the prohibited wrapper but does not meet the repository requirement to use async functions, await, and anyio.Path for filesystem work.
items.recommendation: Refactor the affected command paths and filesystem helpers to native AnyIO asynchronous operations while preserving their observable contracts.
items.rationale: The bugfix must satisfy the native AnyIO filesystem requirement, not merely remove the wrapper call.

items.description: Forced async initialization no longer removes obsolete managed skills and policies.
items.evidence: initialise_distribution_async only treats current destinations as collisions and applies no obsolete removals, unlike initialise_distribution.
items.analysis: The native async path must retain the force-installation contract, including removal of obsolete managed resources.
items.recommendation: Restore asynchronous obsolete managed skill and policy discovery and include those paths in the staged replacement removals.
items.rationale: Accepted to preserve the existing forced-installation behaviour.
